inputs.text: [excited] YOO… oh… ploh… SEF… uh… lus. In Greek, "eu" means well. [curious] And "oplo" is a weapon, an armor — like the Greek soldiers called hoplites!
[happily] Right, "cephalo" means the head. [amazed] All together: the well-protected head. [calm] It lived in Alberta, Canada, seventy-five million years ago.
[confident] A cousin, but even more armored. [amazed] Even its eyelids were covered in bone.
